parsed.restated: (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, derivWithin (v x ·) (Set.Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) = nu • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (p · t) x + f x t) ∧ (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, divergence (v · t) x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, v x 0 = u₀ x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0) ∧ (∀ t ≥ 0, ∀ x i, v (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1) t = v x t) ∧ (∀ t ≥ 0, ∀ x i, p (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1) t = p x t)
parsed.proof:
constructor
· rintro ⟨⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, g, h⟩
  exact ⟨a, b, c, d, e, g, h⟩

parsed.english: (v,p) solves Navier–Stokes with viscosity nu, force f, initial data u₀ for all x and t ≥ 0: the momentum equation holds, v is divergence-free, v(·,0)=u₀, v and p are C^∞ on ℝⁿ×[0,∞), and both v(·,t) and p(·,t) are 1-periodic in every coordinate direction for each t ≥ 0.
parsed.why_clearer: It flattens the nested structure (the extends-parent) into one explicit conjunction and spells out periodicity of velocity and pressure as explicit shift-invariance conditions.
